Glyphkeel is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify it under
the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by the Free
Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or (at your option)
any later version. The licence is in the file LICENSE that comes with
Glyphkeel.

Glyphkeel contains the third-party software listed below. Each part is
distributed under its own licence, whose text is in the last section.
Where a part is offered under a choice of licences, all of them are shown;
Glyphkeel uses it under one that is compatible with the GNU General Public
License. The source code of each part can be had from the addresses given.

This file is generated by `cargo xtask notices` from Cargo.lock,
pnpm-lock.yaml and licences.toml. Do not change it by hand.

The Rust standard library

SQLite
  The database engine, compiled into both programs by the libsqlite3-sys
  crate.
  Licence: blessing
  Source: https://sqlite.org/

  The author disclaims copyright to this source code. In place of a legal
  notice, here is a blessing:

      May you do good and not evil.
      May you find forgiveness for yourself and forgive others.
      May you share freely, never taking more than you give.

SQLCipher
  SQLite with encryption, for encrypted workspaces: compiled into both
  programs on Linux by the libsqlite3-sys crate (from sqlcipher-src), linked
  with the system's OpenSSL.
  Licence: BSD-3-Clause
  Source: https://www.zetetic.net/sqlcipher/
  Copyright: ZETETIC LLC
  Texts: [8]

KaTeX fonts
  The math fonts in the app's interface, which come with the katex package
  (listed with the JavaScript packages). The fonts carry their own licence in
  their metadata: the SIL Open Font License, with the Reserved Font Names
  KaTeX_AMS, KaTeX_Caligraphic, KaTeX_Fraktur, KaTeX_Main, KaTeX_Math,
  KaTeX_SansSerif, KaTeX_Script, KaTeX_Size1 to KaTeX_Size4 and

  Texts: [363]

TextMate grammars

  package (listed with the JavaScript packages), built from the tm-grammars
  package. Each grammar comes from its own project, under that project's
  licence. The tm-grammars notice, with every grammar's source, licence and
  licence text, and the licence of tm-grammars itself are reproduced below.
  Licence: MIT AND Apache-2.0 AND Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND ISC AND MPL-2.0 AND GPL-3.0-only AND LGPL-3.0-only

  Copyright: 2021 Pine Wu, 2023 Anthony Fu (tm-grammars); each grammar's authors, as its notice says
  Texts: [279], [364]

NSIS
  The Windows installer and uninstaller are made with it and contain its code:
  the installer stub under the zlib licence, and the LZMA decompressor of its
  LZMA compression module under the Common Public License with the module
